text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, such as a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests look at how different parts of a system work together. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. Good testing gives developers confidence. When they know their tests are strong, they can make changes without fear of breaking things. In the end, testing saves time and leads to better, more reliable software.
